audit.method: local templates + config/routes.py + live header checks for sameAs/About/Contact
audit.notes: Re-audit after publishing privacy/terms, footer+sitemap links, org-as-author byline + last-reviewed, claim qualification, YouTube sameAs. No Person author invented — Person finding marked not_applicable under org-as-author model.

findings.title: Sitewide Organization JSON-LD present with core trust props

evidence.observed: base.html emits Organization @id #organization with name, legalName, url, logo, contactPoint, sameAs Facebook + LINE + YouTube (@imprintdiamond).

findings.expected: Organization with name, url, logo, contactPoint, sameAs[] on site templates.
findings.recommendation: Keep Organization block; only extend sameAs with confirmed profile URLs.

verification.assertion: Organization JSON-LD includes name, url, logo, contactPoint, sameAs including YouTube

expected_impact.rationale: Tier-1 Organization schema is a documented trust/entity signal for Search and AI extractors; presence is foundational, not a ranking guarantee.

findings.title: About page discoverable from nav and footer

evidence.observed: Route /about exists. Nav and footer link to About/品牌故事; org byline on knowledge pages also links /about.
evidence.snippet: 關於我們 … 銘印鑽石

findings.expected: Discoverable About page linked from global chrome.
findings.recommendation: Keep About linked sitewide; add named team credentials only when real people are ready.

verification.assertion: Global nav/footer contain href=/about and route exists

expected_impact.rationale: Discoverable About is a core E-E-A-T trust surface for brand/entity understanding.

findings.title: Contact page discoverable with NAP + contactPoint

evidence.observed: Route /contact exists. Nav CTA, footer NAP/LINE, page form + JewelryStore/Organization contactPoint.

findings.expected: Discoverable Contact with reachable channels and schema contactPoint.
findings.recommendation: Keep Contact primary; keep footer policy links consistent with published pages.

verification.assertion: Contact route + visible NAP + Organization.contactPoint present

expected_impact.rationale: Contact discoverability and contactPoint support Trust and local entity confidence.

findings.title: Returns/cancellation policy published and footer-linked

evidence.observed: Route /return-policy published; footer links 退款與退貨政策; terms align deposit/cancel with this page; sitemap includes URL.
evidence.snippet: 一經製作或啟動生產流程後，恕無法取消、退貨或退款

findings.recommendation: Keep policy indexable and linked; keep shop calculator terms aligned.

verification.assertion: Footer links /return-policy and template has substantive policy copy

expected_impact.rationale: Visible returns policy is a vertical-appropriate Trust signal for custom jewelry commerce.

findings.title: DNA knowledge page shows process/methodology experience markers

evidence.observed: Page details CVD context, 6-step process, sample quantities, GIA/IGI links, lab-visit CTA; last-reviewed + org byline present.
evidence.snippet: 元素注入生長設備…約需 70–90 天 … 0.20 克拉以上可代送 GIA 或 IGI

findings.expected: Experience markers: methodology, first-hand process detail, verifiable references where claims are made.
findings.recommendation: Keep process depth; refresh last-reviewed when content changes.

verification.assertion: what-is-dna-diamond contains multi-step process and certification references

expected_impact.rationale: First-hand process detail supports Experience/Expertise framing for AI citation and quality raters; not a direct ranking lever.

findings.title: Knowledge pages show org-as-author byline linking to About

evidence.observed: what-is-dna-diamond and about show visible org byline「本頁由銘印鑽石整理與審閱」with rel=author link to /about. WebPage JSON-LD author/publisher → #organization. No invented Person.
evidence.snippet: 本頁由銘印鑽石整理與審閱 · 最後審閱：2026 年 8 月 7 日

findings.expected: Editorial/knowledge pages show named author or clear org-as-author with link to bio/About.
findings.recommendation: Keep org-as-author until a real named expert is supplied; then add Person schema matching visible credentials.

verification.assertion: Org byline with rel=author → /about on DNA and about templates

expected_impact.rationale: Visible org authorship strengthens E-E-A-T on explanatory pages without fabricating Person entities.

findings.title: No Person JSON-LD — intentional under org-as-author model

evidence.observed: Site uses Organization publisher/author on WebPage; no confirmed human author credentials to emit Person. Fabricating Person would be a trust risk.

findings.expected: Person schema only when a human author is shown with matching credentials.
findings.recommendation: Supply confirmed author profile before emitting Person JSON-LD.

verification.assertion: No Person nodes; org author present on knowledge WebPage

expected_impact.rationale: Omitting fabricated Person is correct; org-as-author covers authorship for this vertical until a real expert is named.

findings.title: Privacy policy published, indexable, and complete for current practices

evidence.observed: Draft/TODO/noindex removed. Page covers collection, Google login, imprint_session + GA4, retention windows, rights via LINE/contact, processors limited to Google (no fake payment vendors), effective date 2026-08-07. Route robots cleared; footer + sitemap link /privacy.
evidence.snippet: 生效／最後更新日期：2026 年 8 月 7 日 … imprint_session … G-J5QPK34V89

findings.expected: Indexable, complete privacy policy linked from footer for a commerce site collecting PII.
findings.recommendation: Legal-review before treating as final production law; update if payment processors are added.

verification.assertion: privacy.html has no noindex/TODO/draft; footer and sitemap include /privacy; routes.py has no robots noindex for PAGE_PRIVACY

expected_impact.rationale: Published privacy policy is a high-severity Trust signal for sites collecting personal data.

findings.title: Terms of service published, indexable, aligned with return-policy

evidence.observed: Draft/TODO/noindex removed. Terms cover service, pricing, timeline, deposit/cancel aligned with return-policy, liability, IP, amendment, TW jurisdiction. Effective date 2026-08-07. Footer + sitemap + register still link /terms.
evidence.snippet: 訂金、付款與取消 … 臺灣臺北地方法院 … 生效／最後更新日期：2026 年 8 月 7 日

findings.expected: Published, indexable terms linked from footer/checkout, complete for custom-order commerce.
findings.recommendation: Legal-review before treating as final production law; keep aligned with return-policy.

verification.assertion: terms.html has no noindex/TODO/draft; footer and sitemap include /terms

expected_impact.rationale: Finished terms improve commercial Trust and transparency for custom-order purchases.

findings.title: Footer links privacy, terms, and returns policies

evidence.observed: Footer legal note links /return-policy, /privacy, and /terms. sitemap.xml lists all three.
evidence.snippet: 退款與退貨政策 · 隱私權政策 · 服務條款

findings.recommendation: Keep links when policy URLs change.

expected_impact.rationale: Footer policy discoverability is a clear Trust UX signal.

findings.title: Visible last-reviewed date on knowledge pages

evidence.observed: DNA and about pages show「最後審閱：2026 年 8 月 7 日」; DNA WebPage JSON-LD includes dateModified 2026-08-07 (build/edit day, not backdated).
evidence.snippet: 最後審閱：2026 年 8 月 7 日 … "dateModified": "2026-08-07"

findings.expected: Knowledge pages show last-reviewed date matching real updates.
findings.recommendation: Bump the date when substantive content changes.

verification.assertion: Last-reviewed UI + dateModified present on DNA knowledge template

expected_impact.rationale: Freshness/review transparency supports Trust and AI citation confidence; impact is correlational.

findings.title: Absolute claims soft-qualified with brand-ops attribution + footnote

evidence.observed: 全台唯一 / 60 台 / 十年以上 claims prefixed with「據本品牌營運說明」; footnote cites brand ops source and keeps GIA/IGI links. No invented awards.
evidence.snippet: 據本品牌營運說明，實驗室配置超過 60 台鑽石培育艙，並結合台灣團隊逾十年的高科技與工藝經驗。

findings.expected: Absolute/superlative claims either cited or qualified; experience claims tied to attributable evidence.
findings.recommendation: Replace soft-qualify with third-party citations if/when available.

verification.assertion: Absolute claims on DNA page are qualified or footnoted
verification.reproduce: rg -n "據本品牌營運說明|全台唯一|60" content/site/templates/pages/what-is-dna-diamond.html

expected_impact.rationale: Qualifying absolute claims reduces Trust/AI citation risk without inventing credentials.

findings.title: Live verification of Organization sameAs / About URLs

evidence.observed: Partial live check 2026-08-07: Facebook 200, YouTube @imprintdiamond 200, lin.ee → line.me 200. Production www.imprintdiamond.com/about|/contact return 301 to apex imprintiamond.com which currently 404 — cannot mark About/Contact live pass.

findings.expected: Identity URLs resolve and match the brand entity when checked live.
findings.recommendation: Fix www→apex hosting so /about and /contact resolve 200; then flip this finding to pass. Excluded from score (needs_api).

verification.assertion: HTTP success for Organization.sameAs and /about /contact on production

expected_impact.rationale: Live identity verification affects confidence in entity graph; excluded from score until checked.
